excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集高通量灵能单元，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为无底之物。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Fathomless Being.

texts.zh:

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为无底之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Fathomless Being.

texts.zh:
无底之物从虚境中破土而出。祂的存在无形而宽广，无边无际地在我们的视野中蔓延。

一种有颗粒感的低语从我们身上倾泻而下，冲开了埋藏已久的历史。我们看到被遗忘的帝国在不可阻挡的时间之流中化为灰烬。每一颗冲刷过我们的沙粒都是一段记忆。

在这片浩瀚的档案中，模式出现了——那是野心和毁灭、胜利和衰败的循环。智慧便潜藏于此。

无尽之潮汐伸展超过了时间维度，打磨掉无知，只留下愿意忍受之物。
texts.en:
The Fathomless Being has been unearthed from the Shroud. Formless yet vast, its presence stretches endlessly across the range of our perception.

A textured whisper cascades through us, unravelling long-buried histories. We see forgotten empires ground to dust by the unstoppable march of time. Each grain that washes over us is a memory.

Within this boundless archive, patterns emerge - cycles of ambition and ruin, triumph and decay. There is wisdom within these depths.

The Endless Tide stretches beyond time, wearing away ignorance and leaving only what has the will to endure.

label.zh: 这种智慧现在归我们所有。
